hero.H1: Your website knows the answer. Now it can say it.
hero.Body: Nat learns your website and business knowledge, talks with your visitors, takes their messages, and gets the right conversations to the right people.
hero.Support line: Private beta. Built first for teams that want their website to do more than sit there.

problem.H2: Websites make visitors do too much work.
problem.Body 1: Find the right page. Read the right paragraph. Hunt for Contact. Decide whether to email Sales or Support. Repeat everything again when a human finally replies.
problem.Body 2: Nat turns that maze into a conversation.
problem.Closing line: Ask what you need. Nat handles the first mile.

capabilities: Connect a website and Nat builds approved knowledge from the pages, products, services and information you want visitors to use.
A visitor can ask about the page they are already viewing. Nat should understand “this,” “it,” and “the plan” without making them repeat themselves.
When a visitor needs a human, they can explain the issue to Nat right there instead of hunting for a contact form or email address.
Sales, support, bookings, billing, partnerships or a custom destination. The visitor should not need to understand your org chart.
The business receives the conversation, useful details and a structured summary so the customer does not have to start again.
Nat shows what your site is missing.
Repeated unanswered questions become knowledge gaps you can fix in your website or teach Nat directly.
steps: Connect the domain Nat should learn.
Nat discovers approved public pages and combines them with business knowledge you choose to provide.
Add the Nat embed to your site or use the API when you want a custom experience.
Visitors can ask, explore, leave a request, and move toward the right outcome without navigating your internal process.

routing.H2: The visitor should not need to know who handles what.
routing.Body: Someone wants a quote. Someone has a billing problem. Someone wants a partnership. Nat can take the message, understand the intent, collect what matters and send the conversation where your business has configured it to go.
routing.Microcopy: Email first. Webhooks too. More destinations later.
routing.Closing line: One front door. The right destination behind it.

context.H2: Nat knows what page they are on.
context.Body: If a visitor is already looking at a product, service or pricing page, Nat can receive safe page context so the conversation starts from where the visitor already is.
context.Example Nat: “Yes. The service page says post-launch support is included for 30 days. I can also take a message for the team if you need a longer support arrangement.”

future.H2: Soon, “tell us about your project” can actually mean talk.
future.Body: Nat Brief is designed to take a preliminary client brief through conversation. With voice, a prospect can explain the project naturally, Nat can ask follow-up questions, structure what it heard, and confirm the brief before your first meeting.
future.Closing: Your first human call should begin with context, not “so, what are you looking to build?”

developer.Eyebrow: EMBED WHEN YOU WANT SPEED. API WHEN YOU WANT CONTROL.
developer.H2: Nat is a platform before it is a bubble.
developer.Body: Use the default website widget for fast deployment. Use Nat’s API and SDK foundation when you want to build the experience into your own product surface.
developer.Microcopy: The public site key belongs in the browser. Secret credentials do not.

waitlist.H2: Put Nat on a real website before everyone else.
waitlist.Body: We’re opening Nat to a small group of businesses willing to test it on real websites, share what works, and show us where it breaks.
waitlist.Trust line: No spam. We’ll use your application to evaluate beta fit and contact you about Nat early access.
waitlist.Qualifier line: Best fit right now: active business website + real customer enquiries + willingness to give product feedback.

demo: “Yes. Movo Labs builds web and mobile software, including custom applications. Are you looking to build something?”
“Yeah. A fintech app for my company.”
“I can pass that to the right team. Want me to take a few details here?”
“What’s the best email for the team to reach you?”
Route card appears: “Sales → Movo Labs • context attached”
“Done. I’ve packaged the conversation for the Movo Labs team.”
faq: Nat is being prepared for private beta. This site is collecting early-access applicants before broad public availability.
Nat is designed to learn from approved public website content plus business knowledge you intentionally provide.
No. Nat handles the first mile: common questions, visitor guidance, enquiry capture and routing. Humans remain the escalation point for judgment, sensitive issues and commitments.
The product is being designed to prefer grounded answers and honest escalation over unsupported business-specific claims. No AI system should be presented as infallible.
Can Nat send messages to my team?
That is part of the Core V1 direction. The initial routing model is designed around configured email destinations and webhooks.
Can visitors talk to Nat by voice?
Voice and conversational briefing are planned premium capabilities, not part of the initial Core V1 beta scope.
Nat is being designed API-first. The default widget is one integration surface, not the entire product.
What happens after I join early access?
We’ll review your use case and website. Selected beta partners will be contacted with onboarding instructions and expectations for testing and feedback.
audiences: Turn “I need a quote” into a useful, routed enquiry before anyone from your team replies.
Answer product questions from approved knowledge and carry unsupported issues toward support.
Help shoppers understand what they are already viewing and take post-purchase messages without a contact-page hunt.
Give every visitor a useful first response even when nobody is sitting in live chat.
Deploy the default widget or build a custom interface on top of the Nat integration layer.
